items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: So I used to go listen to him. I'd be at home somewhere, sitting up writing music. So I'd go over and hear him.

ctx.x: Now, by 1928, were the Blue Devils unusual in having arrangements like this? Or were all the bands doing it?
Yes. All the bands was doing it. All of them. The next great man to come down was with the Clouds of Joy -- Sy Oliver. You ever heard of him?
Sy Oliver. Sure, I know Sy.
